statement: ∀ (A B : Set ℤ), (∀ x ∈ A, 0 < x) → (∀ x ∈ B, x < 0) → ∀ (P Q : Set ℤ), P.Nonempty → Q.Nonempty → (∀ F : Finset ℤ, ∃ k : ℤ, ∀ i ∈ F, (i ∈ P ↔ i+k ∈ A) ∧ (i ∈ Q ↔ i+k ∈ B)) → ∃ k : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, (i ∈ P ↔ i+k ∈ A) ∧ (i ∈ Q ↔ i+k ∈ B)

plain_statement.zh: 有限窗口可匹配的混合极限必为原轨道点
plain_statement.en: Recover mixed orbit limits from finite-window matches

brief.zh: 固定两个命中坐标，把平移限制到有限候选。若每个候选都失败，取各自一个反证坐标并合成一个窗口。
brief.en: Anchor one hit in each coordinate. Exclude each of the finitely many shifts with one witness and combine witnesses in a single window.
